title: A predictive, per-engine energy roofline of the Apple Neural Engine
abstract: arXiv:2611.19101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is in over a billion devices, but is characterized indirectly via CoreML. Using a CoreML-free fused-graph dispatch path, we measure the ANE, along with the Apple GPU and CPU on the same device, with per-engine energy accounting. The consumer-available roofline does not predict the ANE in practice. A critical correction is that the ANE sees two effective memory bandwidths: a slow activation path and a fast weight-stream path. Two roofline ridges follow, and the weight-stream ridge is below that of the GPU. The ANE single-operand compute peak decreases instead of plateauing. Its weight stream is byte-bound in fp16 but limited by the dequantizer's element rate in int8. As a result, int8 compression saves energy at unchanged throughput and an int4 lookup-table stream raises throughput and efficiency at a cost of 2.55 points of ImageNet top-1. translated_title: 一种针对苹果神经引擎的预测性、按引擎划分的能耗屋顶线模型
translated_abstract: 苹果神经引擎（ANE）存在于超过十亿台设备中，但此前只能通过 CoreML 间接进行性能表征。我们使用一种不依赖 CoreML 的融合图调度路径，在同一设备上对 ANE、苹果 GPU 和 CPU 进行测量，并实现按引擎的能耗核算。现有面向消费者的屋顶线模型实际上无法预测 ANE 的真实表现。一个关键修正是：ANE 具有两条有效的内存带宽通路——较慢的激活值通路和较快的权重流通路。由此形成两条屋顶线脊线，且权重流脊线低于 GPU 的脊线。ANE 的单操作数计算峰值随计算强度增加而下降，而非趋于平稳。其权重流在 fp16 下受字节数限制，但在 int8 下受反量化器的元素处理速率限制。因此，int8 压缩可在吞吐量不变的情况下节省能耗，而 int4 查找表权重流可同时提升吞吐量和能效，代价是 ImageNet top-1 准确率下降 2.55 个百分点。修正后的屋顶线模型能够识别出 ANE 的低能耗执行路径和边界。
tldr: 本文通过绕过 CoreML 的直接测量方法，首次揭示了苹果神经引擎具有两条不同的内存带宽通路（慢速激活通路与快速权重流通路），并据此提出修正的能耗屋顶线模型，能准确预测 ANE 实际性能并识别低能耗执行路径。
en_tdlr: This paper directly benchmarks the Apple Neural Engine via a CoreML-free dispatch path, reveals its two distinct effective memory bandwidths (a slow activation path and a fast weight-stream path), and proposes a corrected energy roofline model that accurately predicts ANE behavior and identifies lower-energy execution paths.
